_about: Regression for the unsetenv("") panic found by lua_loop. std::env::remove_var panics on an empty name; smelt.os.unsetenv now validates first. If someone reverts that validation, this scenario crashes again.
_fix: 98d397a4 fix(lua): validate setenv/unsetenv name; reject empty/=/\0

LuaSnippet.code:
smelt.os.unsetenv('')
smelt.os.unsetenv('FOO=BAR')
smelt.os.unsetenv('FOO\0BAR')
smelt.os.setenv('', 'x')
smelt.os.setenv('FOO=BAR', 'x')
smelt.os.setenv('FOO', 'x\0y')
